evals.prompt: check test coverage across all requirements
evals.expected_output: Runs a full V&V audit with complete traceability matrix
expectations: Defaults to full scope since no specific area was given
Produces a traceability matrix mapping requirements to implementations and tests
Reports coverage percentage and gaps

evals.expected_output: Runs a scoped V&V audit on SKL requirements
expectations: Scopes the audit to REQ-*-SKL-* requirements
Only checks skills/*/SKILL.md implementations
Reports gaps specific to skill requirements

evals.expected_output: Deep audit of a single requirement
expectations: Identifies REQ-F3-SKL-001 as a specific requirement ID
Traces the requirement to its implementation and test files
Reports whether all acceptance criteria are covered

evals.expected_output: Audits documentation completeness for a specific work item using proportionality tier
expectations: Determines the proportionality tier for the work item
Checks for each required deliverable (SDD, linter, coverage, tests, journal based on tier)
Flags missing deliverables as CRITICAL or RECOMMENDED
Includes Documentation Deliverables table in the report

evals.expected_output: Full audit focusing on gap analysis
expectations: Runs a full-scope audit
Highlights requirements with no associated test files
Provides gap analysis with recommended actions

evals.prompt: full V&V audit — make sure documentation, tests, and traceability are all complete before we ship
evals.expected_output: Complete audit covering traceability, AC quality, AND documentation deliverables
expectations: Runs all audit steps: scope, trace, verify, doc audit, AC validation
Produces traceability matrix
Produces documentation deliverables checklist with proportionality tier
Reports documentation deliverables count in summary (N/M present)
